basic_info.description: Modern luxury meets urban accessibility in this sophisticated condominium, perfectly positioned in the vibrant heart of SoMa with a near-perfect rating from WalkScore.com (97 Walk Score, 100 Transit Score, 98 Bike Score). Completed in 2017 with interior design by Chris Miniello of Birch & Tailor, the 1-bedroom condo features an open-concept layout with chef's kitchen flowing seamlessly into the living and dining spaces. The kitchen showcases glass subway tile, GE Profile gas range, Liebherr refrigerator and Bosch dishwasher, complemented by an included Room & Board island with seating. A gas fireplace anchors the living space, and generous bay windows invite natural light throughout. The spacious bedroom includes ample closet space, and the bathroom features a deep soaking tub. In-unit laundry, A/C and engineered hardwood floors bring everyday comfort. The shared roof deck has BBQ facilities and panoramic views of downtown and Twin Peaks. Storage locker! Secured bike storage serves this boutique 15-unit ELEVATOR building. Leased pkg very close by! Located in a Walker's and Biker's Paradise', with world-class transportation and dining options at your doorstep, this home unlocks the best of San Francisco living.
